task: Pick up the CUP and place it on the TABLE.
plan_summary: Navigate robot CAR to the CUP location, pick it up, navigate to the TABLE location, and place the CUP on the TABLE.
assumptions: The CUP is graspable by the robot CAR
Navigating to within tolerance 1.0 of the CUP's position will bring the robot within interaction_distance to pick it
Navigating to within tolerance 1.0 of the TABLE's position will bring the robot within interaction_distance to place the CUP
